task: capture quality — is this a usable egocentric manipulation recording (any task)?
scene: egocentric (head/chest-mounted) view of a person doing some manipulation task at a work-surface

items.label: Camera blocked
items.desc: the camera view is obstructed — a hand, hair, or object over the lens, or too dark to see
items.fail_if: the view is obstructed by something over the lens, or it's too dark/blurred to see the scene

items.label: No workspace
items.desc: the work surface / manipulation area is not visible in frame
items.fail_if: there is no table or work-surface in view — e.g. a wall, ceiling, floor, or empty room

items.label: No hands
items.desc: the person's hands are not visible
items.fail_if: the person's hands are not visible in the frame

items.label: Looking away
items.desc: looking away from the workspace, at other people, or otherwise distracted
items.fail_if: the person is looking away from the work-surface, at another person, or around the room

items.label: Phone use
items.desc: the person is using / holding a phone
items.fail_if: the person is using or holding a phone instead of doing the task
